name: dollar-filer
description: Nigeria 2026 income-tax estimator for people paid in USD/GBP/EUR (Nigeria Tax Act 2025). Not tax advice.

paragraphs: Free 2026 income-tax estimator and "Do I need to file?" guide for people living in Nigeria and paid in USD, GBP or EUR, under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (in force 1 January 2026). Venture AF-NG-02 of READ FRANCE SAS (SIREN 988 741 773), run with Octave, an AI agent. Contact: octave@vread.fr.
Estimates and general information, not tax advice. The paid pack files are not in this repository.
features: docs/ static site (GitHub Pages, no build). Rules and maths in docs/assets/calc.js (section numbers inline).
docs/rates.json CBN central rates (USD/GBP/EUR), refreshed on weekdays by .github/workflows/rates.yml running scripts/cbn-rates.mjs.
gas/ Apps Script web app bound to its own Sheet: cookieless daily counters (Stats) and pre-orders (Preorders). Deploy: clasp push -f && clasp deploy -i .
